name: L6 Game host: the platformer runs
body: The Nox wrapper over the Nyx C API and `game-host`: the 76 `lantern:::` functions in `docs/game-api.md`, the hooks (`OnFixedUpdate`, `OnUpdate`, `OnRender`) and `HeadlessRenderer`.
acceptance_criteria: The platformer runs unchanged on the Nox engine
The headless game trace matches the Rust engine's within the tolerance
Speed against the Rust build is measured and recorded
Dean runs it on his Mac
definition_of_done: PR into proto, reviewed, with the milestone's checks passing
